title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Relationship and Goal Bonus Rates
content:
Two add-on rates can lift the base yield of a Savings & Money Market Accounts product: a relationship bonus tied to holding a qualifying Personal Checking tier, and a goal bonus tied to saving steadily through a cycle. This schedule lists both, tier by tier.

## Relationship bonus

| Tier | Points added to base APY | Personal Checking tiers that qualify | Combined savings balance on which it is paid, at most (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | 0.00 | none | 0.00 |
| Statement Savings | 0.05 | Everyday Checking, Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 25000.00 |
| Goal Builder Savings | 0.10 | Everyday Checking, Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 25000.00 |
| Money Market Account | 0.15 | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 100000.00 |
| Premier Money Market | 0.25 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 250000.00 |
| Private Client Money Market | 0.25 | Private Client Checking | 1000000.00 |

The ceiling in the last column is measured across all of the customer's savings accounts together, not account by account.

## Goal bonus

| Tier | Points added for a qualifying cycle | Net deposits in the cycle needed, at least (USD) | Daily balance on which it is paid, at most (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | 0.00 (not offered) | not offered | not offered |
| Statement Savings | 0.00 (not offered) | not offered | not offered |
| Goal Builder Savings | 1.75 | 50.00 | 25000.00 |
| Money Market Account | 0.00 (a zero rate) | not offered | not offered |
| Premier Money Market | 0.00 (no goal rate) | not offered | not offered |
| Private Client Money Market | 0.00 (goal route absent) | not offered | not offered |

A goal rate of 0.00 means the tier does not offer the goal bonus.

## Points of judgement

**Is the bonus a rate of its own or an addition?** Both bonuses are percentage points added on top of the base annual percentage yield, never a replacement for it.

**Which tier offers the goal bonus?** Only Goal Builder Savings.

**A hypothetical Goal Builder Savings account ends a cycle with net deposits of 50.00. Is the deposit level met?** Yes; 50.00 reaches the tier's level exactly.
